Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
Election of Members of the Polonnaruwa Municipal Council

NOTICE is hereby given under Section 38(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that the above election is contested and that a poll will be taken between 7.00 a. m. and 4.00 p. m. on 06th May, 2025 and that :-

(a) the names of the candidates in the first nomination paper as indicated by the candidates of each Recognized Political Party for Election as Members of the above mentioned Local Authority, the number and name of the respective wards and the names of candidates in the second nomination paper to be returned; and the approved election symbol allotted to each party; and
(b) the situation of the polling station or stations and the particular polling stations reserved for female voters in the polling district of the above mentioned electoral area,
are specified in the schedule below.
2. The order in which the name of each Recognized Political Party appearing in the Schedule below is the same order in which these particulars will be printed on the ballot paper.

Manoji T. Gurusingha, Returning Officer, Polonnaruwa Municipal Council, Assistant Returning Officer, Polonnaruwa Administrative District, for Returning Officer.Polonnaruwa District Election Office, , 21st March, 2025.
